title: Cleanup: triage 7 stale hex worktrees (feat-managed-agents-autonomy/t0.1..t0.6 + feat-workplan-file-scaffolding/t1.1)
resolution_note: Per-branch `git log main..<branch>` audit confirmed all 7 branches had ZERO unique commits — they were either never started or fully merged into main. Removed via `git worktree remove <path>` + `git branch -D <branch>` for each. No archive/* renames needed because there was no work to preserve. Final `git worktree list` shows only the main checkout.

done: Swarm evaluation on 2026-04-14 identified 7 untracked worktree directories under repo root, all pointing at branches last updated ~4 days ago at commit cb8350c.
No workplan file matches the feat-managed-agents-autonomy or feat-workplan-file-scaffolding names — these branches have no corresponding plan/spec.

steps.description: For each of the 7 branches (feat/feat-managed-agents-autonomy/t0.{1..6}, feat/feat-workplan-file-scaffolding/t1.1) run `git log main..<branch> --oneline` to determine if any commits exist that are not already on main. Record findings in this workplan's notes.
steps.done_condition: per-branch commit delta recorded; classify each as EMPTY (no unique commits) or HAS-WORK (commits not on main)

steps.description: For EMPTY branches: run `hex worktree remove <path>` then `git branch -D <branch>`. For HAS-WORK branches: enqueue a `hex worktree merge` workplan to integrate, OR rename the branch to `archive/<name>` if the work is not wanted. NEVER use raw `git checkout` to pull files — rule G4 (ADR-2604131630) forbids it because it silently drops code.
steps.done_condition: git worktree list shows only the main checkout; git branch -a shows no feat-managed-agents-autonomy/* or feat-workplan-file-scaffolding/* branches outside archive/

notes: Hard rule: never `rm -rf` a worktree directory — use `hex worktree remove` or `git worktree remove` which cleans the worktree registry as well.
If any branch has unmerged work, the default choice is PRESERVE (rename to archive/) not DELETE. The cost of a dangling archive branch is ~0; the cost of lost code is high.
